title: Data Reuse and the Long Shadow of Error: Splitting, Subsampling, and Prospectively Managing Inferential Errors
summary: When multiple investigators analyze a common dataset, the data reuse induces dependence across testing procedures, affecting the distribution of errors. Existing techniques of managing dependent tests require either cross-study coordination or post-hoc correction. These methods do not apply to the current practice of uncoordinated groups of researchers independently evaluating hypotheses on a shared dataset.
